problem_statement.task: Does the page load correctly and run without errors?
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Open the browser developer tools Console panel 2. Load the page and wait for complete rendering 3. Check if the Console has any red error messages (JavaScript errors) 4. Check if the Network panel has any failed resource requests (404/500)
problem_statement.expected_result: Page loads completely, Console has no red errors, Network panel has no failed requests (404/500), all static resources (CSS/JS/images/fonts) load successfully
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 10 points; JavaScript runtime errors deduct 5 points; Resource 404 errors deduct 3 points; White screen or crash results in 0 points; Warnings only do not deduct points

problem_statement.task: Verify the central orb renders and animates as a fluid physics simulation
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Refresh the page and focus on the center of the screen 2. Observe the orb without interacting 3. Move the mouse cursor near or over the orb
problem_statement.expected_result: A central circular element is visible with a 'liquid metal' texture (monochrome/silver highlights). The texture continuously morphs/animates (is not static). It responds to mouse movement or oscillates organically.
problem_statement.criteria: Pass: Orb exists and animates fluidly. Fail: Static image, simple CSS rotation, or missing orb. Deduct 5 points if animation is jerky or low frame rate.

problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Click the central liquid orb 2. Verify a modal/dialog appears 3. Enter text into 'I need to...' field and select a time 4. Click the 'Set Reminder' button
problem_statement.expected_result: Clicking the orb triggers a smooth fade-in of the reminder configuration modal. Clicking 'Set Reminder' closes the modal and triggers a 'Reminder set' status toast notification.
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 15 points. Deduct 10 points if clicking the orb does nothing. Deduct 5 points if the modal lacks input fields or closing animation is abrupt.

problem_statement.task: Verify the Orb's active state visual transformation
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Successfully set a reminder (as per previous task) 2. Observe the color change of the orb 3. Check for text rendering within the orb area
problem_statement.expected_result: The orb transitions from Monochrome (Silver/Black) to a vibrant Electric Blue/Cyan/Glowing state. The reminder task text and time are displayed elegantly within or overlaid on the orb.
problem_statement.criteria: Pass: Color changes to blue/cyan AND text appears. Deduct 10 points if color remains monochrome. Deduct 5 points if text is missing or illegible.

problem_statement.task: Verify task completion and state reset functionality
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. With a reminder active, click 'Mark as done' or 'Clear Reminders' button 2. Observe the status toast notification 3. Observe the orb's visual state
problem_statement.expected_result: A 'Reminder completed' or 'Cleared' toast appears. The orb transitions smoothly back to its original 'Idle' state (Monochrome liquid metal), removing the blue glow and text.
problem_statement.criteria: Pass: Orb reverts to initial visual state. Deduct 10 points if the orb remains blue or retains the old task text.

problem_statement.task: Verify switching between different Visualizer Modes
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Locate the vertical icon bar on the right side of the screen 2. Click on at least 3 different icons (e.g., glitch, contour, black hole) sequentially 3. Observe the orb's rendering style after each click
problem_statement.expected_result: The visual engine changes the orb's rendering significantly (e.g., switching to horizontal neon lines, topographical contours, or gravitational lens effects) corresponding to the selection.
problem_statement.criteria: Pass: Distinct visual changes occur for different modes. Deduct 5 points if buttons are unresponsive or changes are negligible.

problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Trigger any action (Set/Clear reminder) 2. Check the appearance of the toast notification 3. Inspect the modal or button backgrounds against the black background
problem_statement.expected_result: Toasts float at the top and fade out automatically. UI elements (modals/buttons) exhibit 'glassmorphism' (semi-transparent dark background with thin borders/blur) rather than solid opaque colors.
problem_statement.criteria: Deduct 2 points for missing toasts. Deduct 3 points if UI elements are solid opaque colors without the specified glass effect.

problem_statement.task: Evaluate whether the interface visual design meets professional design standards
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. View the webpage screenshot to assess whether the overall color scheme is harmonious 2. Check if the layout spacing is reasonable (whether element spacing follows the 8px multiple principle) 3. Check if the typography system is professional (body font size ≥14px, line height exceeds 1.5x)
problem_statement.expected_result: The interface follows modern design principles: harmonious and unified color scheme, reasonable and standardized layout spacing, professional and clear typography system
problem_statement.criteria: Deduct 5 points for each instance of crowded visual elements, deduct 6 points for jarring color combinations, deduct 5 points for chaotic text and image layout

problem_statement.task: Evaluate the visual quality of the Liquid Metal simulation and Dark Mode execution
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Examine the 'Idle' state of the orb in a screenshot 2. Check the contrast between the orb highlights and the pure black background 3. Verify the 'High-gloss' liquid texture appearance
problem_statement.expected_result: The design must feature a deep pure black (#000000) background. The orb should look like high-quality, high-contrast liquid metal (white flowing highlights on black), not a low-resolution flat gradient or simple shape.
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 15 points. Deduct 10 points if the orb looks flat/cartoonish (lacks depth/gloss). Deduct 5 points if background is grey/gradient instead of deep black.
